name: github-explore
description: Search, discover, summarize and audit GitHub through the gh CLI: find repos about a topic, map a field landscape, trending, repo overviews, similar projects, code search, issue/PR search and org audits — backed by 9 zero-config Python scripts with relevance ranking and quota-aware searching. Read-only by default; opt-in write management (repos/issues/PRs/workflows/secrets/releases) requires target, impact and minimal-data disclosure plus explicit user confirmation before execution.
